01.local_env_matrix.criticalPath: L0 + alpha + beta + gamma + prod(package/purity/release-verify) serial; exclusive local runtime switch
01.local_env_matrix.cacheModeNotes: warm soft=600s; cold may use hard=1800s or COLD_CACHE_EXEMPT then require a warm re-run. prod-hosted SSH deploy is NOT in this budget.

02.service_pipeline.criticalPath: workflow run created_at -> candidate completed_at, including queue and setup waits

03.delivery_gate.criticalPath: promotionReadyAt -> mainReadbackAt; includes hosted queue, immutable evidence verification, merge and exact ref readback
03.delivery_gate.machinePath: promotion_verify only; no build, source test, packaging, ABG, Provider live, device or self-hosted job

06.rc_qualification.criticalPath: explicit admitted RC -> build/sign/attest once -> final package/provider/UAT/supply-chain QualificationFact
06.rc_qualification.machinePath: release-qualification factory and external package validator; asynchronous after main

07.stable_tag_prod.criticalPath: stable ReleaseTagAdmissionFact -> ProdActivationAdmissionFact -> canary/5/20/50/100 -> terminal release or rollback
